g.text: Learning request — current CLI ask sequence
build RunContext with policy, request, participant
Reused ID with different payload, or a pending result,
raises StateConflict; it is not run a second time.
check input and context match; select eligible specializations
order graph; check role, mode, topics, activities,
build brief with task, approved evidence, dependencies
check kind, citations, coverage, role, review
check citations/coverage and no claimed state change
PARTIAL_RESULT if any task failed or has findings
create pending ChangeProposal records if any
Search opens a fresh MCP stdio subprocess per call.
Mock search is the alternative configured backend.
An execution exception is converted to a safe FAILURE
and the claimed request is finished with that result.
